content.value_statement: Postage costs vary by mail type, weight, destination, and service. This skill guides your assistant through official Chunghwa Post tables to report applicable rates and query dates.
actual_capabilities: Direct the assistant to official tables for domestic letters, parcels, express mail, and international letters.
Guide domestic letter rate lookup by weight tier and ordinary, registered, or time-limited service.
Explain postcard, letter sheet, registration, and time-limited service charges using fetched tables.
Provide an HTTPS download example and guidance for parsing nested HTML tables and normalizing full-width characters.
Require the assistant to ask for missing weight and report the service type, applicable tier, and query date.
Guide honest reporting of unavailable sources and uncertain international rate zones.
limitations: Requires an assistant with network access and suitable retrieval tools; the skill supplies instructions rather than a standalone calculator.
Does not support shipment tracking or post office location searches.
Rates and page structures may change; recorded examples do not establish current prices.
International letter quotes require destination zone information; the skill does not provide international parcel or EMS rate tables.

use_cases.title: Estimate Personal Mailing Costs
use_cases.description: Check ordinary and registered domestic letter costs from the current official table before mailing personal documents.

use_cases.title: Check Domestic Parcel Rates
use_cases.description: Find the official domestic parcel table and identify the information needed to estimate shipping charges.

use_cases.title: Plan International Letter Mailing
use_cases.description: Consult international letter tables by destination and weight, and disclose uncertainty when the rate zone is unclear.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Postcard Rate
prompt_templates.prompt: What is the current postage for one ordinary domestic postcard in Taiwan? Use the official table and include the query date.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: one mail type and service.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Letter Services
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare ordinary and registered postage for a 20-gram domestic letter in Taiwan. Show the weight tier, registration charge, source, and query date.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Parcel Estimate
prompt_templates.prompt: Help estimate postage for a 2-kilogram domestic parcel in Taiwan. Ask for missing route or packaging details and consult the official parcel table.

prompt_templates.title: Check an International Letter
prompt_templates.prompt: Check ordinary and registered rates for a 50-gram letter from Taiwan to Japan using current official tables. Report the zone, surcharges, and uncertainties.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: destination zones and service charges.

output_examples.input: Using the skill's dated example, what did an ordinary 20-gram domestic letter cost?
output_examples.output: The documented September 19, 2026 example lists TWD 8 for an ordinary domestic letter up to 20 grams. This historical example is not a current quote.

output_examples.input: How much does a registered domestic letter cost? I do not know its weight.
output_examples.output: What is the letter's weight in grams? The weight tier determines base postage, and registered service adds the applicable registration charge.

output_examples.input: Give me today's postcard postage even if the official page cannot be retrieved.
output_examples.output: The official rate page could not be retrieved, so I cannot verify today's postage. I will not substitute the skill's historical example.

best_practices: Provide mail type, weight, service, and destination before requesting a quote.
Fetch the current official table and include the source, query date, and applicable weight tier.
Use a private temporary file for downloads and report source failures or uncertain destination zones explicitly.
anti_patterns: Treating the skill's dated sample rates as verified current prices.
Guessing weight tiers, registration charges, or international destination zones.
Using this skill for shipment tracking or post office location searches.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. It uses publicly available Chunghwa Post pages without an API key or login.

faq.question: Which mail types does it cover?
faq.answer: It references domestic letters, postcards, letter sheets, parcels, express mail, and international letters.

faq.question: Are the sample rates current?
faq.answer: The examples are dated September 19, 2026. Current quotes require retrieving the official table and reporting the query date.

faq.question: Can it track a shipment or locate a post office?
faq.answer: No. Shipment tracking and post office location searches are outside its stated scope.

faq.question: What happens when a rate page is unavailable?
faq.answer: The instructions suggest retrying with a browser user agent. Continued failure should be reported without quoting remembered rates.

faq.question: Does it calculate postage automatically?
faq.answer: It provides lookup and parsing instructions, not a standalone calculator. Your assistant needs retrieval tools and sufficient shipment details.
